messages:
Maya Patel: Hey team — Sparkline cohort seats just landed (10 seats) and finance flagged this account as high touch. Need help sequencing onboarding + feedback capture. Can we get a 45m enablement next week and a short preflight checklist? @Joon @Priya :wave:
Joon Kim: Congrats! I can run the enablement. Prefer Tue/Wed morning. Will need SSO details and whether they want live Q&A or just walkthrough + recording. Shared a draft agenda: https://calendar.redwood.ai/sparkline-onboard-draft
Priya Rao: I can own the feedback pipe. Recommend we ship a short NPS + three targeted prompts after session. Also request API key rotation for preview keys before we open seats. Quick example payload we can use for the survey webhook:
```
POST /feedback
{
  "customer": "sparkline-inc",
  "cohort": "sparkline-alpha",
  "q1": "How likely are you to recommend? (0-10)",
  "q2": "Top friction point in integration?",
  "q3": "What feature would change usage?"
}
```
Liam O'Connor: I can run a preflight runbook and do a seat-provisioning sweep today. Will check org-level quotas and create the RBAC roles they need. ETA for sweep: by EOD. Also will prepare a one-pager for client success highlight (config snippets + common gotchas). :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Perfect — can everyone ack tasks? Also renewal manager flagged this as medium-term risk if they don't see value in 60 days. Let's make onboarding -> first-success within 14 days a priority.
Joon Kim: Ack. I'll block Tue 10am PT / Wed 9am PT options on the draft. Planning: 15m intro, 20m walkthrough, 10m Q&A + next steps. Will record.
Priya Rao: Ack. I'll wire up the survey webhook and a short follow-up drip (3 emails over 2 weeks). Will include an ask for a sample dataset for quality checks.
Liam O'Connor: Ack. I'll post the preflight checklist here after sweep. If quota issue, I'll tag infra.
CS Bot: Ticket CS-4382 created for Sparkline cohort onboarding (owner: Maya Patel). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-4382
Maya Patel: Thanks all — once Joon confirms times I'll send the official invite and onboarding doc. Keep comments here for blockers. :heart:
